description: This file defines internal data structures and functions for managing native enum types in pybind11, including the native_enum_data class, functions for handling enum finalization, and module import utilities.

classes.name: native_enum_data
classes.description: Internal class managing native enum data, including finalization and registration within pybind11.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes the setup of the native enum, creating the Python enum object and registering it.

methods.name: disarm_finalize_check
methods.description: Prevents double finalization by checking and resetting the finalize_needed flag.

methods.name: arm_finalize_check
methods.description: Sets the finalize_needed flag, asserting it was not already set.
